Description.name: Bb$enior
Description.description: Is this a member of the bb$quad who's advanced to the Elder stage? The bb$enior's appearance and cane would certainly support that theory, but the Monster still seems remarkably spry. Is its raspy, strained singing voice merely a shtick, perhaps to entertain or bamboozle its fellow performers? Then again, that somewhat lackluster puff of smoke it emits could mean that the Monster's best fire-spitting days are behind it. Still, there's no doubt that this wily, wizened wisecracker has one or two tricks-of-the-trade that the others would benefit from, so respect your seniors!.
